_doc: Personal (class) quests. Each hero can carry one: the hero asks for it at camp, the party tracks the objective, a quest node (star, violet) is added to the current zone when the quest starts, and the party reacts by relationship on completion. Objective types: skill_kills (kills by listed skills), skill_hits, skill_uses, skill_heal, heal, kills_tag (enemy template matches), weapon_kills (weapon subtype), named_kills, fights_unbroken (wins with no hero down), crits, statuses, status_type, rests, nodes (new nodes visited), node_types, loot, salvage. reward: talent (points), xp, gold, item {category, rarity}.
